text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back.** Reps cut post-call admin by about 40 minutes a day. That went straight into more customer visits.

**2. CRM data got better.** Next steps and objections were logged consistently, so forecasts stopped relying on memory.

**3. Consent matters.** Asking permission up front built trust. Customers appreciated the transparency.

**4. Coaching changed.** Managers reviewed real conversations instead of rep summaries, and feedback got more specific.

**5. Noisy sites are hard.** Accuracy dropped in loud environments, so we still recommend a quick manual check.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It gave reps more time to use it.

What has your team learned from AI pilots?
